visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair and bangs stands in a brightly lit indoor studio with plain white walls. She wears a white spaghetti strap tank top and black shorts. She holds a large stack of folded clothes wrapped in clear plastic bags. The text 韓系3套冬天穿搭 is displayed at the top of the frame. She looks at the camera with a cheerful expression and moves the bundle of clothes. (2) The scene cuts to the woman wearing a grey and white horizontal striped sweater with a unique choker-style neckline. She is paired with a white layered ruffled mini skirt, white socks, and chunky cream sneakers. The setting remains the minimalist white room with soft, bright indoor lighting. She poses by placing a hand on her chin, then moves her arms and waves at the camera while smiling. (3) The woman holds up a red knitted sweater featuring white Nordic snowflake patterns. She first appears in a white button-down shirt, then transitions instantly to wearing the red sweater over the shirt. She completes the ensemble with white wide-leg trousers and a white quilted bag. She puts on clear-framed glasses and touches her hair, looking into the lens in the same bright indoor environment. (4) She holds a light blue cropped tweed jacket and a pair of wide-leg blue denim jeans. The scene transitions to her wearing the jacket over her original white tank top and the jeans. She adjusts a gold necklace and her earrings. She poses with her hands in her pockets, displaying the full outfit against the plain background, and ends the video with a friendly wave.
